score_metric_note: GDT_TS is on 0-1 scale; GDT_TS_percent is on 0-100 scale (same value × 100). lddt_ca (lDDT-Cα) is the primary benchmark metric. Scoring used --match-mode sequence (Needleman-Wunsch Cα alignment). References extracted from mmCIF using the manifest chain_id and residue range.
